summary: runtime-reference.md:172-177 gives the boundary as four steps: `evolve loop-stop` and wait; merge console PRs with gh; `evolve sync-main` then `evolve gc`; then `evolve loop-stop --release` and a launch. The operator runs them one at a time in a shell, judges at each step whether the last one succeeded, and launches the loop with nohup. A skipped or failed step (a merge while a lane still runs, a launch on an unsynced plane) is found later.
